@{5b7752c93ed6fb25028c6549|full_name}: Not any more, no.

These were used (albeit in a basic way) for the Power Chords event, where we could have a sign at the entrance saying what the current week's music theme was without having to reupload the world.

Working webpanels would also allow our DnD group to load our character sheets in without having to update the in-game objects.
We are thinking of adding such a feature, but it would also allow anyone to execute arbitrary code on your personal machine-- is that okay?

Okay, seriously though, I don't want to sound annoying, but I'm absolutely frustrated at the moment because I counted on this possibly more than you could imagine. I was going to publish a website for my news articles. I've been making them for over 11 months straight, and re-uploading my world every week has already been beyond annoying for a while, but I wanted to announce new changes on the anniversary, which should be in September. Take a look at some of the things I made just for my project. I don't know if you like it, and I guess it doesn't matter to anyone except me, but I want to say that there's a lot of work put into prefabs with such things as web panels.
